newsitem.title: FRANCE: Russia's Lebed starts French visit.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Lebed starts French visit.

text.p: Former Russian security chief Alexander Lebed arrived in France on Sunday for a five-day private visit during which he will meet political leaders but not government ministers.

General Lebed was limping when he arrived at the airport and aides said he was suffering from an in-grown toenail which forced him to cancel planned visits to Napoleon's tomb and the French army museum.
French radio said he would be treated later by the doctor of the Paris St-Germain football team.
Lebed, who was sacked by President Boris Yeltsin last October, was to give a television interview later on Sunday.
During his visit, he will meet the presidents of the National Assembly and the Senate as well as Socialist opposition leader Lionel Jospin.
He will also meet several prominent members of the ruling Rally for the Republic (RPR) Gaullist party, including Senator Philippe de Gaulle, son of former president Charles de Gaulle.
